content.text: {"problem": {"theorem": "证明对任意实数 a，都有 sqrt(a^2)=|a|。", "assumptions": ["a 为实数。"], "domain": "elementary_algebra", "explicit_subgoals": []}, "target": {"node_id": "n1", "version": 1}, "target_node": {"text": "平方与开平方互相抵消，所以 sqrt(a^2)=a。", "claim": "声称平方与开平方互相抵消，从而对实数 a 有 sqrt(a^2)=a；该等式在 a<0 时不成立。", "scope": [], "depends_on": [], "goal_refs": []}, "closed_predecessors": [], "patch": {"base_state_digest": "cfbd4e5250b0707e098b804b5bb99c709582b7d99217da435b57c1841a4e70bd", "certificate_id": "4a78551136937cb223cc5d139e0fd336471d2d5f954f8ead59722ec87159097f", "target": {"node_id": "n1", "version": 1}, "operation": "replace", "nodes": [{"node_id": "n1", "text": "因为 a 为实数，所以 |a|≥0，且 |a|²=a²。由非负平方根的唯一性，sqrt(a²)=|a|。", "claim": "对任意实数 a，都有 sqrt(a²)=|a|。", "depends_on": [], "scope": [], "goal_refs": []}], "target_dependencies_after": [], "counterexample": null, "reason": "原节点误将主平方根视为平方的双侧逆；替换后利用 |a| 的非负性、|a|²=a²以及非负平方根的唯一性直接证明原定理。"}, "patch_digest": "f2e7cddb25239e0e51e9b7a183f0feb33011ef38e9fce912ec7a1a51e7f72010", "certificate": {"certificate_id": "4a78551136937cb223cc5d139e0fd336471d2d5f954f8ead59722ec87159097f", "problem_digest": "79a9995fa0ed98b0b6d73c54623a91e6d07410c6a372adbafc84bfb92782004d", "target": {"node_id": "n1", "version": 1}, "graph_digest": "e58d1abe6fdff2c8fd0535139807a29052fac4a0097b70c6b4ac02615ee14b7b", "confirmation": "confirmed", "kind": "invalid", "failed_edge": "从“平方与开平方互相抵消”推出对所有实数 a 都有 sqrt(a^2)=a。", "quote": "平方与开平方互相抵消，所以 sqrt(a^2)=a。", "reason": "该推断忽略了 sqrt 表示非负主平方根。取 a=-1，则 sqrt(a^2)=sqrt(1)=1≠-1=a；正确恒等式是 sqrt(a^2)=|a|。"}, "proposed_proof": "因为 a 为实数，所以 |a|≥0，且 |a|²=a²。由非负平方根的唯一性，sqrt(a²)=|a|。\n又因为每个实数 a 都等于 |a|，所以 sqrt(a^2)=|a|。"}
